entry.idea: Students find school and training hard to follow, so simpleclub offers learning apps with short videos and practice, and now sells training to businesses.
entry.lesson: Win over users with a product they love, then sell the same skill to businesses.
entry.name: simpleclub

growth.reason: No user or revenue numbers found, but it has raised several rounds.

market.reason: Education and staff training are real markets, though language and country focus limit reach.

tech.reason: Good learning content and apps, but a strong team could copy the approach in months.

entry.twist: It started as a study app for students and carries that simple, student-style teaching into company training.
entry.who_pays: Students pay for the app, and companies pay for the business training product.
entry.why_now: Companies need to train staff fast, and people are used to learning from short videos on their phones.
